SELECT DISTINCT "name", "event_space", "capacity"
FROM "eventspaces"
WHERE ("event_space" LIKE '%Banquet Hall%' OR "event_space" LIKE '%Conference Room%')
  AND "capacity" = 200;
3:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT "name", "food_service"
                FROM "restaurants"
WHERE "cuisine" = 'Italian'
  AND ("food_service" = 'Restaurant' OR "food_service" = 'Café')
            ) sub
            ORDER BY "food_service" ;

SELECT *
FROM "restaurants"
WHERE "food_service" ILIKE '%Restaurant%'
   OR ("food_service" ILIKE '%Café%' AND "cuisine" ILIKE '%Italian%');
5:
SELECT DISTINCT *
FROM "restaurants"
WHERE ("food_service" LIKE '%Restaurant%' OR "food_service" LIKE '%Café%')

6:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT s."name",
    s."role"
                FROM "staff" s
WHERE (LOWER(s."role") LIKE '%chef%')
   OR (LOWER(s."role") LIKE '%server%' AND LOWER(s."language") LIKE '%english%')
            ) sub
            ORDER BY s."role", s."name" ;
7: SELECT * FROM "staff" WHERE ("role" ILIKE 'Chef' OR "role" ILIKE 'Server') AND "language" ILIKE 'English';
108:
SELECT mr."salary"
FROM "medicalroles" mr
WHERE mr."roleid" IN (
    SELECT hmr."roleid"
    FROM "hospitals_medical_roles" hmr
    GROUP BY hmr."roleid"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hmr."hospitalid") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "hospitals")
);
109:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT sp."name" AS specialist_name, s."system_name" AS system_name
                FROM "it_support_specialists" sp
JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" ss ON sp."id" = ss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN "systems" s ON ss."system_id" = s."system_id"
            ) sub
            ORDER BY sp."name", s."system_name" ;
110:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT "s"."name" AS "specialist_name",
    "sys"."system_name",
    "sys"."is_active"
                FROM "it_support_specialists" "s"
INNER JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" "iss" ON "s"."id" = "iss"."it_specialist_id"
INNER JOIN "systems" "sys" ON "iss"."system_id" = "sys"."system_id"
            ) sub
            ORDER BY "s"."name", "sys"."system_name" ;
111:
SELECT "iss"."name", "s"."system_name", "s"."is_active"
FROM "it_support_specialists" "iss"
JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" "isss" ON "iss"."id" = "isss"."it_specialist_id"
JOIN "systems" "s" ON "isss"."system_id" = "s"."system_id";
112:
SELECT r."responsibility"
FROM "responsibilities" r
JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
GROUP BY r."id", r."responsibility"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "internships");
113:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT i."title", r."responsibility"
                FROM "internships" i
JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
            ) sub
            ORDER BY i."title", r."responsibility" ;
114:
SELECT 
    "iss"."name" AS "specialist_name",
    "s"."system_name" AS "system_name"
FROM "it_support_specialists" "iss"
JOIN "it_support_specialists_systems" "isss" ON "iss"."id" = "isss"."it_specialist_id"
JOIN "systems" "s" ON "isss"."system_id" = "s"."system_id"
ORDER BY "specialist_name", "system_name";
115:
SELECT *
            FROM (
                SELECT DISTINCT i."title" AS "Internship Title",
    r."responsibility" AS "Responsibility"
                FROM "internships" i
JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON i."id" = ir."internshipid"
JOIN "responsibilities" r ON ir."responsibilityid" = r."id"
            ) sub

FROM "jobs"
